sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) 
FROM Patient p 
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID 
WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') AND l.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
